integrity: Exact integer exhaustive lower-bound verification and separately reconstructed witness. Source-level originality assessed to best available literature evidence; independent audit has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Connected unweighted bipartite networks; optimal one-to-one allocation after independent exchangeable pollinator losses. Finite exhaustive bound only through eight species, with a nine-species witness; no claim about biological outcomes, correlated failures, larger size classifications or external verification.
title: Nine species are sharp for a degree-controlled reversal in ecological matching capacity
